name.description: Display label for the tag, rendered as x-displayName in the OpenAPI document

external_docs.description: Absolute URL of the documentation page for the tag, rendered as externalDocs.url in the OpenAPI document

x-displayName.description: Not allowed. Set the display label with the name key instead, which is rendered as x-displayName

^x-.description: OpenAPI specification extension, passed through to the tag entry unchanged
